text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Trainer had a dream where someone bid 
them farewell. But they can't remember who 
it was. Just who could it have been...?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
What brought back those memories was a 
doll. Aston Machan's Machan plushie. Yet, 
the girl herself was nowhere to be found.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before long, they found her by the sea. As 
she turned toward the water saying 
"Goodbye," the Trainer held her back.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Not just in memories, but by your side. 
Aston Machan's story starts here. Those 
words... stopped her in her tracks.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"Because you're a strange person," she 
says, turning her back to the ocean. The 
legend of Aston Machan never ends.
